query: WITH failed AS (UPDATE ops.provider_connection_tests SET status='FAILED', redacted_result=$2,completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$1 AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') RETURNING provider_id) UPDATE ops.provider_configs p SET last_connection_test_at=clock_timestamp(), last_connection_test_status='FAILED' FROM failed WHERE p.id=failed.provider_id
